response.sql: SELECT o.orderbase AS channel, AVG(e.fillcount) AS avg_filled_quantity, COUNT(*) AS execution_count, COUNT(*)::numeric / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS share_of_total FROM orderexecutions AS e JOIN orders AS o ON e.ordersmark = o.recordvault GROUP BY o.orderbase;

assumptions.assumption: The count and share use matched execution rows, including rows with a missing fillcount. AVG(fillcount) ignores those missing values.

alternatives.interpretation: Count distinct executed orders per channel and calculate each channel’s share of distinct executed orders; average fillcount still uses matched executions.
alternatives.sql: SELECT o.orderbase AS channel, AVG(e.fillcount) AS avg_filled_quantity, COUNT(DISTINCT o.recordvault) AS order_count, COUNT(DISTINCT o.recordvault)::numeric / SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT o.recordvault)) OVER () AS share_of_total FROM orderexecutions AS e JOIN orders AS o ON e.ordersmark = o.recordvault GROUP BY o.orderbase;
